perplexity.description:
Daffodils & Dirt is the debut studio album by Sam Morton, an English rock duo composed of singer Samantha Morton and producer Richard Russell. Released on 14 June 2024 through XL Recordings, the album presents a deeply personal and musically rich world across twelve tracks, blending elements of rock with atmospheric and experimental textures shaped by Russell’s production.

This album marks the first full-length collaboration between Morton and Russell, following their initial singles released in 2023. Critically, Daffodils & Dirt received universal acclaim, with reviewers praising its emotional depth and innovative sound. John Murphy of MusicOMH described it as "one of the most startling albums of the year," highlighting the duo’s rare chemistry, while Matt Young of The Line of Best Fit noted the album’s overwhelming sense of light and hopefulness. Commercially, it reached number 61 on the UK Album Downloads chart and number 17 on the UK Independent Albums chart, reflecting a strong reception for a debut release on an independent label.
